subs.text: Want to run a Race to Frame promotion around a race weekend? A few quick steps, and the Desk handles the rest.
Choose the frame you want to promote. Its existing product photo and shop link come with it.
Name the race weekend and set your total advertising budget. This example uses a £150 cap.
Choose your campaign dates, platforms and audience location.
Use the product photo already on your shop site, or upload a new one. Tell the Desk what the ad should focus on — for example, celebrating a race finish with a personalised frame.

actions.fill: Celebrate the finish. Give your race-day achievement a place on the wall.

subs.text: The Desk prepares your campaign draft, ready for you to review.
Your frame becomes a feed post and a Story, ready for your social media ad campaign.
Tailor the headline and copy before approving. The photo, wording and call to action remain yours to review.
Check the product, dates, audience and maximum spend together, including the exact shop destination.
Each promotion leads straight to that product in your existing shop — a shorter route from celebrating a finish to framing it.
Approve the creative, destination, audience, dates and spending cap. Nothing goes out without your say-so.
Connect your advertising account and the Desk can schedule and deliver your approved campaign within those limits.
The same process supports your next coaching intake. Choose Sculpt & Shape and the destination changes to its enquiry form.

actions.fill: Eight weeks of structured workouts and progression. Enquire about Sculpt & Shape.

subs.text: Your products and coaching, promoted under your own brand — all from your Desk.
